gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: UI Guide
UI Layout & 3-Step Enchanting
Mode tabs, dual slots, list rows & Sanctum console
Five simple areas let you enchant, upgrade, or cleanse any item in three steps:
Use the top tabs to switch between Enchant & Cleanse; open/close this guide without dropping items.
Put your gear, book, or base item in the Top Slot and any cycled main material below.
Click any highlighted row on the left; any secondary item is taken automatically from your bag.
Hover material icons to see all accepted swaps; hover XP badges to see exact shelf discounts.
Bookshelves
Bookshelf Roles & 7×5×7 Scan
Wall-piercing 7×5×7 scan, upgrades & stored books
Scans +/-%s horizontal & +/-%s vertical blocks (7×5×7) as long as open breathing room remains around the table.
Unenchanted Items: With Regular Bookshelves alone, fresh gear starts up to half max level (e.g., III of V).
Upgrading Existing Enchants: Once level I is on the item, 0–%s Regular Bookshelves unlock upgrades all the way to MAX.
Chiseled Master Tomes: Stored books unlock full tiers directly at 1–3L (16 charges per level by default; 4 per book copy).
Live Sync
Shelf and book changes update open menus live within 1 second.

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Book Loop
Book Upgrades & Paying the Difference
2-book Combine, 1-book Upgrade & fair step pricing
Two easy ways raise low-level books to MAX, and gear upgrades automatically deduct prior materials:
Combine 2 Books (0 Items): Put matching books in Top & Bottom Slots for 0.6x XP; the lower book turns into 1 Depleted Tome.
Upgrade 1 Book (Save Books): Put 1 book on top + regular materials or 1x Arcane Synthesis Crystal below at 1.4x XP.
Pay the Difference: Upgrading existing gear enchants deducts prior items automatically — and costs just 1–2L with a stored book.
Master Tome Charges (16 Uses)
A stored Tome gives 16 gear uses per level (4 per book copy), stepping down 1 level when spent!

Mending, Swift Sneak, Locking & instant Refresh
Treasure enchantments like Mending, Silk Touch, and Infinity unlock in two reliable ways:
Way 1 [Store a Book]: Put any found Treasure Book in a Chiseled Bookshelf for permanent 1–3L single-item enchanting.
Way 2 [Treasure Epiphany]: With %s+ Regular Bookshelves, new Treasures roll every 10 min (up to %s at once with more stored books).
Unstored Epiphanies use 2 matching items (e.g. Diamond + Amethyst), or just 1x Arcane Synthesis Crystal.

Transmute XP Bottles & Depleted Tomes right away; Echo Shards, Totems, Tridents & Enchanted Apples unlock once discovered.

Cleanse
Disenchant, Lower Level & Purge Curse
Free wipe, 1-level step-down, strip 1 & curse purge
Switch to the teal Cleanse tab to modify enchanted gear or books in four ways:
Disenchant All (0 Items): Clears all non-curse enchants and spawns XP orbs; emptied books turn into Depleted Tomes.
Lower Level (0 Items): Drops a chosen enchant by 1 level and refunds XP orbs; a solo level I book turns into a Depleted Tome.
Strip 1 Enchant: On multi-enchant gear, spend Lv.3–10 (-1~3L) with Grit + Lapis/Glow Ink/Amethyst, vanilla Amethyst+Lapis, or 1x Crystal to remove 1 enchant cleanly.
Purge Curse: Spend 12L Full XP (up to -35% shelf discount) with Grit + Ghast Tear/Golden Apple, 2 Ghast Tears + 2 Golden Apples, or 1x Crystal to remove curses!
